requirements_summary: Mid-market subscription SaaS (billing/subs) seeking an LLM-driven support agent that can: (1) ingest customer billing context and surface next-actionable steps; (2) call payments/billing tools (Stripe, Zuora) to create refunds, credits, schedule invoices; (3) return strict JSON for audit + downstream systems; (4) stream responses to agents for perceived latency <250ms; (5) fall back to smaller model or allow read-only views during failure.
poc_success_criteria: p95 latency for agent-ready message <300ms on hosted_api with streaming enabled; JSON tool-calls parsable by backend (schema v1) >=98% pass rate; end-to-end Stripe refund via function-call in test env; ability to scale to 25 concurrent agent sessions w/ <10% CPU throttling.
technical_notes: Prefer Redwood hosted_api for quick POC. Key asks: streaming chunked responses, tool-calling hooks for Stripe/Zuora, deterministic structured outputs (JSON schema), audit log hooks (event ids), and model pinning. Performance concerns for month-end billing spikes -> interested in dedicated reserved capacity pricing and burst window options. Zuora integration: majority of flows still SOAP, requires small adapter; Stripe flows are straightforward (webhook + API).
integration_details: Primary flows for POC: (A) agent asks to refund last invoice -> LLM returns JSON {action: 'refund', amount_cents: 4500, currency: 'USD', external_ref: 'ticket-998'} then Redwood function-call triggers Stripe refund in sandbox. (B) Invoice adjustment via Zuora -> LLM emits structured update -> adapter maps to Zuora SOAP call. Team wants full request/response logs for audit and ability to redact PII in logs.
commercial_notes: Estimated ARR band 60k-180k. Finance requests committed capacity quote for Dedicated covering two monthly peaks (3x baseline) with option to enable burst pay-as-you-go. Interested in usage discount tiers and clear token-based billing examples for streaming scenarios. AE provided draft term sheet (see drive link).
